text_blocks.snippet: Losartan can cause mild side effects like dizziness and fatigue, as well as serious risks such as high potassium or kidney issues.

list.snippet: Dizziness: Lightheadedness can happen when your blood pressure drops or when you stand up too quickly.
Fatigue: You may feel tired while your body adjusts to lower blood pressure.
Cold Symptoms: Stuffy nose, sneezing, or upper respiratory infections can occur.
Digestive Upset: Mild nausea, vomiting, or diarrhea may happen, which can sometimes be helped by taking the medicine with food.
Aches: Back pain or joint pain have been reported by some patients.
High Potassium (Hyperkalemia): Can cause muscle weakness, confusion, or an irregular heartbeat.
Kidney Problems: May lead to swelling in your hands, ankles, or feet, or changes in how often you urinate.
Low Blood Pressure (Hypotension): Can cause severe dizziness, fainting, or blurred vision.
Severe Allergic Reactions (Angioedema): Can cause dangerous swelling of the face, lips, tongue, or throat, making it hard to breathe.
Pregnancy Risk: Do not take losartan if you are pregnant, as it can harm or end an unborn baby's life.
